svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 1150 mm lengths of 60 x 30 x 2 RHS, square ends. Stand them

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on edge (60 mm tall). The right and left rails are mirror images.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Distances from the rear end; heights from the bottom face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear axle slot through both side walls: 17 mm tall, 30 to 75 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the rear end, centred 42 mm up. Drill 17 mm at each end, saw out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front axle hole through both walls: 10.5 mm, 1100 mm from the rear

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end, 42 mm up; weld a 16 x 3 mm tube 26 mm long inside between them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside wall: four 9 mm holes for M6 rivet nuts at 130, 430, 730 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top face: four 9 mm holes for M6 rivet nuts on the centre line at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Right rail only: 8.5 mm hole through both walls at 50 mm, 22 mm up,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and an M8 nut welded over it outside (drag screw).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left rail only: 12 mm grommet holes in the outer wall at 60 and 1135 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 26 mm up (harness), and two M3 rivet nuts inside at 1092 and 1108 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 16 mm up (sensor bracket). Full layout: picture rail-holes.png.
